description: This file contains utility functions for handling JSON files, path normalization, integrating with the Vitest testing framework, and collecting test duration data. It is likely a utility script used within a larger project for testing and reporting purposes.

methods.name: normalizeRepoPath
methods.description: Converts a file system path to a normalized POSIX-style path with forward slashes.

methods.name: normalizeTrackedRepoPath
methods.description: Converts an absolute or relative path to a normalized repository-relative path, handling absolute paths and relative paths consistently.

methods.name: readJsonFile
methods.description: Reads a JSON file and parses its content into a JavaScript object.

methods.name: tryReadJsonFile
methods.description: Attempts to read and parse a JSON file, returning a fallback value if an error occurs.

methods.name: writeJsonFile
methods.description: Serializes an object to JSON and writes it to a file with formatting.

methods.name: runVitestJsonReport
methods.description: Executes the 'vitest' test runner via pnpm in a child process and outputs a JSON report to a specified path.

methods.name: collectVitestFileDurations
methods.description: Processes test report data to extract durations and test counts per file, applying normalization to file paths.
